
import base64
from Crypto.Cipher import AES

KEY = b'CROWNX64-ENCRYPTION-KEY-12345678'
BLOCK_SIZE = 16

def unpad(s):
    return s[:-s[-1]]

enc_b64 = """"""
enc_data = base64.b64decode(enc_b64)

iv = enc_data[:16]
cipher = AES.new(KEY, AES.MODE_CBC, iv)
decrypted = cipher.decrypt(enc_data[16:])
code = unpad(decrypted).decode('utf-8')

exec(code)
